item.title: How much money does Carlee Russell still owe Alabama over her kidnapping hoax?
item.description: Nearly three years after her story of being abducted along I-459 resulted in a days-long search and nationwide media coverage, only for it to be revealed as a lie, Carlee Russell is still trying to pay off the thousands of dollars she owes to the Hoover Police Department for the hoax.
